entry_points.text: Firmware discovery builds window, binds ID, creates NUMA node and probes one ITS; bringup resets all before probing any and frees mappings; top init pools and allocates tables, discovers, surveys version-four and registers suspend-resume; version-four caches parent and element sets; reservation installs hotplug step when firmware and nodes exist; logical needs build plus distributor cap unless boot-disabled.

Exception entry delegates by interrupt state; hotplug start enables registers and initializes CPU and translation; validation rejects broken redistributors; power notifier restores on exit and quiesces on entry; power control wakes by clearing sleep with bounded polling. Build without power management provides empty init.

Translation accepts single cell, device-tree triple and firmware pair rejecting low values; selection matches by identity and token or primary domain; device-tree init maps windows, validates version, applies quirks, builds partitions and records virtualization info, unwinding on failure. Reservation conflicts warn without failing; out-of-range indices warn and continue; one family skips second type read.

exports.text: Expose hardware number and effective versus configured affinity, with processor-zero fallback when uniprocessor.
Allocator forwards or fails by build; register helper enables access; type helper derives private count; NMI macros bracket handling.

hazards.text: Write-pending and power timeouts only log and continue; unexpected dispatch warns once and deactivates; unrecognized class warns preserving offset.

invariants.text: IDs split into local, shared, extended and logical; spurious ignored, separated completion skips logical and forwarded; unknown maps fail; per-CPU and shared bind different dispatch with probe and enforced context; affinity hints only for device-tree private, else all CPUs; partitions from child node skipping malformed.

Identifier count is power of two, shared capped at 1020; version accepts two generations; boot programs Group1 defaults then enables; quirks match by compatible, masked ID or property; T241 steers shared reads across four aliases, needing three chips by SoC ID before mapping.

Local classes use per-CPU base, shared use distributor base; extended IDs rebased with redirects; mask toggles one bit per 32-entry word with drain on mask only; state queries below logical threshold map pending, active and masked; retrigger sets pending.

Nonmaskable needs build plus runtime support, rejects enabled and logical, swaps priority and handlers; software signals fixed rising edge, shared accept level or edge; affinity rejects local, picks online CPU with quiesce; virtual forwarding set or cleared except software signals; uniprocessor disables affinity, signaling and symmetric init.

CPU identity packs affinity levels; signaling groups by cluster with barriers; discovery walks regions to last; CPUs match by affinity or warn; caps intersect with virtual cleanup; per-CPU setup enables Group1; CPU init discovers, enables and quiesces; one erratum applies only for shared excluding local; mismatches are critical errors; helpers resolve current record with affinity bits 4-7.

locks.text: Descriptor lock must be held across nonmaskable promotion and demotion.

state_machines.text: Boot samples priority bits, probes group zero by write-read round trip, reads security state, forces disabled security or forbids nonmaskable, caching both.

Enabled path uses running priority to choose dispatch; disabled path restricts mask around acknowledgment; completion separates priority drop from deactivation when supported, deactivating unhandled after warning; one implementation needs explicit ordered active clear.

Allocation maps a consecutive run stopping at first failure; release clears handlers; nonmaskable needs active masking and clear forbid; base init captures addresses, applies quirks, creates domain, allocates state with unwind, then runs dispatch, priority, distributor, CPU, nonmaskable, SMP and power setup, with fallback warning in observed headers.

structs.text: Region holds mapped and physical bases with single flag; chip aggregates firmware handle, distributor bases, region array, domain, flags, range support, private count and partitions.

Partition pairs mask with firmware ID; boot storage records distributor mapping, regions, counts and maintenance interrupt, registering one region per call. Virtualization publication is a no-op here.
Two descriptors share caps, one unified completion, other split with virtual affinity, chosen by split-deactivate; domain ops publish translate, alloc, free, select and info.

Sixteen software signals, four T241 max, default mask 240; logical base 8192, spurious 1020-1023, shared from 32 with eight signals below 16; private base 16 plus 32 or 64; workarounds low four bits; nonsecure priority shifted left; device-tree offsets warn past limits, message passthrough, single cell below 16; chip bits 45-44, offset 0x1580000, SoC 0x036b0241; log prefix identifies GICv3.
